scope.prepared_snapshots: streamed 2019Q1–2025Q4; first-occurrence positive labels, historical product support, and candidate relations independently derived
scope.prediction_stream_coverage: all eligible candidate pairs; deterministic sampling: none; every none score/rank/label and EOF checked

tolerance.integers_and_strings: exact; booleans are not accepted as integers
tolerance.candidate_ids_hash: exact SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON list, ensure_ascii=False

input.edge_derivation: first-occurrence pairs from each streamed snapshot; only positive labels on products with historical reports and problems already in history
input.candidate_rule: all historical problem IDs minus product's historical problem IDs, sorted lexically
input.support: historical product_reports before the evaluated snapshot

selection_lock_order.ordering_basis: local Linux file birth and trace modification timestamps; traces contain fit_started before quarter evaluation and each test trace is born after its allowed predecessor

reconstruction.method: GraphSageRanker.from_checkpoint for each raw none30 checkpoint; ranking rescored from raw product/problem input vectors and self_weights

paired_C_mean30.origin: reused from pinned C; no mean fit and no old C score audit rerun

recomputed_none_metrics.aggregation: sum raw numerators and denominators across 2024Q1–2025Q4 before division; not an average of annual recalls

limitations: mean30 is reused pinned C evidence; D1 does not retrain it or rerun its prior score audit
none uses self-only aggregation but retains trainable node identity vectors; model capacity/gradient paths are not a pure causal intervention
positive-only historical candidate cohorts do not establish precision or broad clinical utility
no independent confirmation, new seeds, bootstrap, or confidence interval
